prophet: Ibn Abbas said this is the last whole surah that came down to the Prophet ﷺ. (An-Nasa'i, told by Ibn Kathir.)
When this surah came down, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'My death has been announced to me.' He passed away that same year. (Ahmad, from Ibn Abbas.)
scholars: Ibn Kathir says 'the help of Allah and the Conquest' means the day Makkah was opened to the Muslims. Before that, many tribes of Arabia waited. They said, 'If Muhammad wins over his own people, then he is a true prophet.'

Ibn Abbas, Umar and others: some older men at Badr only thought it meant 'thank Allah when you win.' Ibn Abbas told Umar it was a sign that the Prophet's life was almost done. Umar said, 'I know nothing about it other than what you said.' (Sahih al-Bukhari.)

prophet: The Prophet ﷺ said that Allah told him he would see a sign among his people, and when he saw it, he should praise Allah and ask forgiveness. Then he said, 'And I have seen it,' and read this surah. (Ahmad and Muslim, from Aisha.)
scholars: Ibn Kathir says that less than two years after Makkah was opened, all of Arabia had become Muslim. Every tribe said they believed.
The book Al-Jalalayn says people used to come one by one, and now they came in big groups.

prophet: Aisha said the Prophet ﷺ often said when he bowed and when he put his head down in prayer: 'Glory to You, our Lord, and praise to You. O Allah, forgive me.' He was following what the Quran told him. (Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.)
Near the end of his life he said often: 'Glory to Allah and praise to Him. I ask Allah to forgive me and I come back to Him.' (Ahmad, from Aisha.)
scholars: Ibn Kathir explains: when you get a big win, do not be proud. Say thank you to Allah, and ask Him to forgive you. Allah accepts people who come back to Him.
The book Tanwir al-Miqbas (from Ibn Abbas) says: this surah told the Prophet ﷺ that he would die soon.
